notes: Move publication_phase through not_started -> pr_open -> merged_waiting_visibility -> visible_waiting_install_proof -> install_proven_waiting_upgrade_proof -> upgrade_proven as the public winget lane advances. Set pending_version when a public submission is in flight. Set public_install_proven only after merged + visible + fresh-VM published-source install/check-update/uninstall proof, then set current_public_version to the proved public version. Set public_upgrade_proven only after a later published-to-published winget upgrade proof, then update current_public_version to the latest proved public version. Keep automation_enabled false until both proofs are true and the team intentionally turns on automated update PRs.
